meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 分析代码时会先做结构索引,再用三个专用工具查代码:按关键词找符号、看文件结构骨架、只展开需要的函数源码,而不整篇读文件。这样节省 token。
howto.when: 当你要理解代码结构、查找函数或探索代码库时触发;遇到超过约100行的代码文件,它会优先用结构化工具代替直接读文件。

say.text: 用 smart_search 在 src 里找 shutdown 相关的函数
say.note: 返回带路径和行号的符号列表及文件概览。

say.text: 给 worker-service.ts 生成一个结构大纲
say.note: 列出该文件里的函数和类。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude explores code via structural indexing: it uses smart_search, smart_outline, and smart_unfold instead of reading whole files, producing symbol lists, file skeletons, and individual function source.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or efficiently explore a codebase; for code files over ~100 lines, it prefers structural tools over direct reads.

say_en.text: Use smart_search to find shutdown-related functions in src.
say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols with paths and line numbers.

say_en.text: Generate a structural outline of worker-service.ts.
say_en.note: Lists all functions and classes in the file.

say_en.text: Unfold the full implementation of performGracefulShutdown in GracefulShutdown.ts.
say_en.note: Shows the complete source of that symbol.
